sections.heading: Pitch Overview
sections.text: Prepared on 7 November 2024, pitch SYN-SYNCP000125-P1 was put before Sunrise Care Partners 125 on behalf of Supplier.

sections.heading: Put Forward in Exchange
sections.text: In exchange the Supplier put forward a group service charge of 2.5 per cent.

sections.heading: Sought in Return
sections.text: The Supplier sought a yearly Influenza minimum take of 650 doses in return.

sections.heading: Recorded Result
sections.text: Recorded result: the Customer came back with a counter.
